lines.label: Income tax (England & Northern Ireland rates)
lines.note: EMI: discount (lower of MV at grant and at exercise, minus the price) plus any post-disqualifying-event gain (ETASSUM57030, 57070). Not readily convertible assets: no PAYE; you pay through Self Assessment.

source.title: HMRC Employee Tax Advantaged Share Scheme User Manual ETASSUM57030 (charge on the exercise of discounted EMI options), ETASSUM57070 (discounted option after a disqualifying event), ETASSUM57180 (NIC), ETASSUM57190/57200 (CGT); GOV.UK Tax and Employee Share Schemes: EMI

lines.label: Employee Class 1 National Insurance
lines.note: No NIC: the shares are not readily convertible assets (ERSM170010).

source.title: GOV.UK: Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027 (Class 1 National Insurance thresholds and rates)

notes: EMI: assumes the option is a qualifying EMI option (company and employee requirements, £250,000 limit). Granted at a discount: the lower of the discount at grant and the gain at exercise (£2,000) is charged (ETASSUM57030).
Tax at sale uses the 2026-27 rates with your salary as the other income of the year of sale and no other gains.
Estimate only, not tax advice: scheme rules, residence and other income change the result.
